english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for carrying out tasks, having a job, providing a service, or describing how someone performs.
This is the all-purpose choice when perform means to do or execute something, such as an experiment.
Use 做 as the all-purpose verb for doing something or taking action.
Use this when “have” means to do or undertake an activity, such as having a look or having a meeting.

examples.english: I do this job, mainly helping people fix computers.
examples.traditional: 我做呢份工，主要係幫人整電腦。
